resources.string: Shows a user-controlled floating button. When you tap it, TapCopy takes one screenshot, recognizes visible text on-device, and lets you copy the text you choose. It does not read passwords, type for you, automate other apps, or upload screenshots.
TapCopy only captures the screen after you tap its floating button. Text recognition happens on this device. Screenshots are stored temporarily in the app cache and deleted after use.
